steps.label: open the Tiles tab
steps.goal: the kit lives on the tile tab's list, and the key list changes with the tab
steps.recovery: if a text field has the keyboard the number types into it: press Escape first

steps.label: reopen tile_4 from the kit
steps.goal: tile_4 ships wrong: its low wall sits dead centre, so all four edges derive open and the solver treats it as a second floor tile
do: walk down the tiles list to site/tile_4 -- Escape first if a piece is in hand
steps.recovery: Escape backs out to the meshes page; if Enter opens nothing you are not on the tiles page -- press left

steps.label: flush the low wall against a side
steps.goal: once the wall touches the boundary that face derives closed -- and flush is the last stop on the arrow ladder, so one plain press from centre lands it
do: press , or . until the low wall is the focused piece
press the plain arrow toward a side -- or hold Shift for the flush verb
steps.recovery: if nothing moved, it is already flush on that axis: pick another side

steps.label: save the repair
steps.goal: Cmd+S writes over the committed tile_4, and the kit is one tile better than it shipped
steps.recovery: if the save is refused the panel names why -- the id is already good, so it will be the members

steps.label: does tile_4 read as a tile now
steps.goal: the question the whole repair serves, and the one no checkpoint can answer
do: look at it in the 3d view
say what still bothers you about the kit flow -- reopening, walking, anything
steps.recovery: there is nothing to recover here: an answer of no is the finding
